name: SearchScopes
remarks: You can't add or remove SearchScope objects from the SearchScopes collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SearchScopes object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SearchScopes object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a SearchScope object that corresponds to an area in which to perform a file search, such as local drives or Microsoft Outlook folders. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the SearchScopes object. Read-only.
